descriptions.w3d_d32e_play_named_clip_801dc9a8: Plays a named sound clip from a bank: hands the bank's interface (at +124) to the caller's reference, fails with E_FAIL if the bank is not ready, then searches the categories for the name. When several consecutive items share the name, picks one at random; finds the player whose id equals the clip key and forwards to its play method. Returns 0 if nothing was found.
